In January 2018, debut author Josh Farkas visited Medium.com to discuss his book Quitting, which he writes serves as a cautionary tale for those considering a career quit vehicle to found an online company.
According to Farkas, he and his team started incubating their business, The Art of Quitting, after becoming fed up with their previous nine to five job in August three years earlier.
They had a straightforward idea for a business intended to assist others in learning how to quit their jobs. To establish the business, they printed some flyers and distributed them in the neighborhood where they were located to advertise their newly formed company.
